approach.name: Catalogue first
approach.description: Categories and best sellers up top, quick to shop, little preamble.

pages.label: Announcement bar
pages.approach: Categories and best sellers up top, quick to shop, little preamble.

sections.label: Store promise line
sections.intent: One short, warm line with the store's main promise or current offer code, like free delivery over a set amount or easy returns. A short link at the end leads to the offer, so shoppers of any kind of store know the deal at a glance.
sections.layout: a single centred line on a white bar with a thin bottom rule, the short link set in the one accent colour at the end

pages.label: Header
pages.approach: Categories and best sellers up top, quick to shop, little preamble.

sections.label: Logo, search and menu
sections.intent: The store fills in its own logo. Search is wide and prominent because a catalogue-first store of any category, from groceries to auto parts, is shopped by searching. Account and cart sit within easy reach.
sections.layout: logo left and a wide search box on the first row with account and cart icons right; a thin rule, then the category menu as a quiet text row below; on phones a c

pages.label: Home
pages.approach: Categories and best sellers up top, quick to shop, little preamble.

sections.label: Shop by category
sections.intent: Opens straight into the catalogue with almost no preamble. The store's own categories, whatever they are, appear as picture tiles. The largest tile goes to the lead category, so shoppers are one tap from what they came for.
sections.layout: bento grid with one large tile on the left and smaller tiles stacked around it, thin white gutters, category names set small at the bottom-left of each tile

sections.label: Shop-by-occasion tabs
sections.intent: Shop-by-occasion tabs, each with its products
sections.layout: a heading pinned beside a list

sections.label: Tabs
sections.intent: Tabs: new in / best sellers / on sale
sections.layout: two columns: picture on one side, words on the other

sections.label: A testimonial carousel with ratings
sections.intent: A testimonial carousel with ratings
sections.layout: centered narrow column with generous space

sections.label: How it is made in three steps
sections.intent: How it is made in three steps
sections.layout: a heading pinned beside a list

pages.label: Product listing
pages.approach: Categories and best sellers up top, quick to shop, little preamble.

sections.label: All products title
sections.intent: Tells shoppers where they are and how much there is to browse, kept brief so the products start quickly.
sections.layout: a slim band under a thin rule: breadcrumbs above, the title on the left, the result count right-aligned on the same line

sections.label: Jump to a category
sections.intent: Lets shoppers narrow the whole catalogue to one of the store's categories in a single tap before they use the filters.
sections.layout: one horizontal row of thin-outlined text chips that scrolls sideways on phones

sections.label: Browse and filter
sections.intent: The full catalogue with filters suited to any category: price, brand, size, rating and availability. Sort sits above the grid.
sections.layout: filters in a narrow left column; on the right, the sort menu above a grid of four cards per row, one column of filters folding into a drawer on phones

pages.label: Category pages
pages.approach: Categories and best sellers up top, quick to shop, little preamble.

sections.label: Category heading
sections.intent: Every category opens with a clear typographic header. The breadcrumbs come first, then the name from <Category> set large with its product count and the description beside it. Below sit the subcategories from <SubCategories> as picture tiles, which hide when there are none.
sections.layout: asymmetric 7/5 split: the oversized name and count on the left, the short description on the right; a thin rule, then a row of small square subcategory picture

sections.label: Products in this category
sections.intent: The products of <Category> in a wide, uncluttered grid. The result count and sort sit on top, and the filters slide in from a drawer, so the products get the full width.
sections.layout: a toolbar with the result count left and the filter button and sort menu right, over a full-width grid of four cards per row

sections.label: Questions and details
sections.intent: Quiet help for shoppers still deciding. The category's questions from <CategoryFaqs> come first in an accordion, then its longer copy from <SeoText>. Each hides when empty.
sections.layout: a centred narrow column with generous space above and below, the accordion on top and the plain text beneath

pages.label: Brand pages
pages.approach: Categories and best sellers up top, quick to shop, little preamble.

sections.label: Brand introduction
sections.intent: Opens every brand page with breadcrumbs, then the logo and name from <Brand> beside its tagline, short description and links to its website and social pages.
sections.layout: two columns under a thin rule: the logo on a plain white square on the left, the name, tagline, description and links on the right

sections.label: Shop this brand
sections.intent: Every product from <Brand>, with filters for category, price and rating so shoppers can find the right item within the brand.
sections.layout: filters in a column on the left; on the right, the result count and sort over a grid of three cards per row

sections.label: About the brand
sections.intent: The fuller story from <Brand> and its longer copy from <SeoText>, for shoppers who want to know who makes what they buy. Each hides when empty.
sections.layout: a centred narrow column with generous space, the story first and the longer text below a thin rule

pages.label: Search results
pages.approach: Categories and best sellers up top, quick to shop, little preamble.

sections.label: Your search results
sections.intent: Shows the term and the number of matches from <SearchQuery>, with the search box ready to try again. The matching products sit below with filters and sort.
sections.layout: a slim band holding the term, the count and the search box in one row; below it, filters in a left column beside the results grid with sort on top

sections.label: Try a category
sections.intent: For shoppers who did not find what they wanted, the store's own categories from <Categories> offer another way in.
sections.layout: a centred heading over a single row of round category pictures with names underneath

pages.label: Product page
pages.approach: Categories and best sellers up top, quick to shop, little preamble.

sections.label: Product and buying
sections.intent: Everything needed to buy in one view: pictures, title, rating, price with any discount, stock, options, quantity, add to cart and buy now. A pincode delivery check matters to shoppers across India.
sections.layout: a thumbnail rail and a large picture on the left; a sticky buy box on the right with thin rules between its groups and the add to cart button in the one accent

sections.label: Details and specifications
sections.intent: The description and the specifications, folded neatly so the page fits any kind of product, from a kurta to a phone charger.
sections.layout: a centred narrow column with an accordion: description open by default, specifications below

sections.label: What buyers say
sections.intent: Customer reviews with the average rating shown big, so shoppers can trust the choice quickly.
sections.layout: the heading and an oversized average rating number pinned on the left, the list of reviews scrolling on the right

sections.label: You may also like
sections.intent: Related products from the same category to keep shoppers browsing.
sections.layout: a full-width band with a centred heading over a sideways carousel of product cards

pages.label: Cart
pages.approach: Categories and best sellers up top, quick to shop, little preamble.

sections.label: Free delivery progress
sections.intent: Shows how close the shopper is to free delivery, a gentle nudge for mid-priced baskets.
sections.layout: a slim full-width band with a thin progress line in the accent colour and one line of text

sections.label: Your bag
sections.intent: The items in the cart with quantities and prices, beside the summary, coupon box and checkout button. A friendly empty state appears when there is nothing yet.
sections.layout: cart lines on the left separated by thin rules; a sticky summary card on the right with the coupon box above the checkout button and trust badges beneath

sections.label: Add before checkout
sections.intent: A few small, useful add-ons chosen from the store's catalogue, added with one tap.
sections.layout: a horizontal scroller of compact product cards under a small left-aligned heading

pages.label: Checkout
pages.approach: Categories and best sellers up top, quick to shop, little preamble.

sections.label: Checkout steps
sections.intent: Contact, address, delivery choice and payment in a clear order, with the order summary always visible so there are no surprises.
sections.layout: form steps on the left divided by thin rules, a sticky order summary on the right; on phones the summary folds open first

sections.label: Safe and supported
sections.intent: Reassurance at the moment of paying: secure payment, easy returns and how to get help.
sections.layout: a quiet centred band in three columns, each with a thin-line icon and one short line

pages.label: About
pages.approach: Categories and best sellers up top, quick to shop, little preamble.

sections.label: Our opening line
sections.intent: The store introduces itself with its founding year shown big and one warm sentence about why it exists. The store fills in its own words.
sections.layout: an oversized founding year as the graphic, with a single sentence set small beneath it, centred in generous white space

sections.label: Our story
sections.intent: A few short paragraphs on how the store began and whom it serves, with one picture of the team, the shop or the products.
sections.layout: asymmetric 7/5 grid: the words on the wider left side, the picture on the right

sections.label: How we choose
sections.intent: Three simple promises about picking products, pricing them fairly and delivering them well, written to fit any category.
sections.layout: three cards that overlap slightly and sit offset vertically, each with a thin-line icon and two lines of text

sections.label: What customers say
sections.intent: Real customer words that build trust in a new store.
sections.layout: a centred card floating over a pale tinted background, with reviews turning slowly inside it

sections.label: Start shopping
sections.intent: A closing invitation to browse the store's categories.
sections.layout: a full-bleed picture with one line and a link overlaid at the bottom-left

pages.label: Contact
pages.approach: Categories and best sellers up top, quick to shop, little preamble.

sections.label: Ways to reach us
sections.intent: Phone, email, WhatsApp and address, so shoppers anywhere in India can pick the way they prefer.
sections.layout: the heading pinned on the left beside a list of channels on the right, each with a thin-line icon and separated by thin rules

sections.label: Common questions
sections.intent: Quick answers on delivery, returns, payment and order tracking before shoppers need to write in.
sections.layout: a centred narrow column with an accordion and generous space

sections.label: Call or write today
sections.intent: A brief, warm nudge to get in touch, with the store's hours.
sections.layout: a centred card floating over a pale tinted band, with two links side by side

pages.label: All categories
pages.approach: Categories and best sellers up top, quick to shop, little preamble.

sections.label: All categories
sections.intent: Every category from <AllCategories> as a picture tile, with its subcategories listed beneath, so shoppers can see the whole store at once.
sections.layout: breadcrumbs and a centred heading over a mosaic with one large tile, the remaining tiles in an even grid

sections.label: Browse everything
sections.intent: A closing invitation to browse every product for shoppers who prefer to scroll.
sections.layout: a slim band under a thin rule: one line on the left, a link in the accent colour on the right

pages.label: All brands
pages.approach: Categories and best sellers up top, quick to shop, little preamble.

sections.label: All brands
sections.intent: The featured brands from <AllBrands> are shown large first, then every brand appears as a logo wall, so shoppers loyal to a name can find it fast.
sections.layout: breadcrumbs and a centred heading, a row of large featured logo cards, then a dense wall of small logos divided by thin lines

sections.label: Browse everything
sections.intent: A closing nudge to see every product across all brands.
sections.layout: a heading pinned on the left beside a single link and a short line on the right

pages.label: Footer
pages.approach: Categories and best sellers up top, quick to shop, little preamble.

sections.label: Store line and links
sections.intent: Closes every page with the store's own line, link columns for help, shopping and policies, and its social links, with a small newsletter signup.
sections.layout: a large store line with the logo on the left beside three link columns on the right; a slim bottom bar under a thin rule holding the social icons and the newsle

pages.label: Sign in
pages.approach: Categories and best sellers up top, quick to shop, little preamble.

sections.label: Centred sign-in
sections.intent: Centred sign-in: a short welcome line in the store voice over <SignInForm /> on a softly tinted band, the store name small under it
sections.layout: on a softly tinted surface with generous space

sections.label: Reassurance strip
sections.intent: Reassurance strip: a secure sign-in with a one-time code, orders and returns in one place, saved addresses, as three short notes with icons
sections.layout: type-led, with one accent colour

pages.label: Sign up
pages.approach: Categories and best sellers up top, quick to shop, little preamble.

sections.label: Join split
sections.intent: Join split: a brand panel with the reasons to create an account (every order in one place, saved addresses, a quicker checkout, a wishlist) beside <SignUpForm />
sections.layout: on a band in the brand colour with light text

sections.label: What an account gives
sections.intent: What an account gives: orders in one place, saved addresses, a wishlist, as three short notes with icons
sections.layout: calm, with generous side space

pages.label: Account pages
pages.approach: Categories and best sellers up top, quick to shop, little preamble.

sections.label: Account frame
sections.intent: Account frame: a quiet heading strip with a short line about the shopper’s corner of the store, then <AccountPage /> full width
sections.layout: type-led, with one accent colour

sections.label: Help band
sections.intent: Help band: where to get help with an order, returns and the policies, as a few quiet links (/support, /return-policy, /legal)
sections.layout: calm, with generous side space

pages.label: Order details
pages.approach: Categories and best sellers up top, quick to shop, little preamble.

sections.label: Order page
sections.intent: Order page: a quiet strip with a short line in the store voice, then <OrderDetail /> full width
sections.layout: type-led, with one accent colour

sections.label: Help with this order
sections.intent: Help with this order: contact options from <Store> and links to returns (/return-policy) and support (/support)
sections.layout: calm, with generous side space

pages.label: Wishlist
pages.approach: Categories and best sellers up top, quick to shop, little preamble.

sections.label: Wishlist
sections.intent: Wishlist: a quiet title strip with the h1 and a short line, then <WishlistGrid /> full width
sections.layout: type-led, with one accent colour

sections.label: More to love
sections.intent: More to love: best sellers from <Products> as the site’s product cards, under a short heading
sections.layout: type-led, with one accent colour

pages.label: Compare
pages.approach: Categories and best sellers up top, quick to shop, little preamble.

sections.label: Compare
sections.intent: Compare: a short heading band (the page’s h1) with a line on choosing well, then <CompareTable /> full width
sections.layout: calm, with generous side space

sections.label: Help choosing
sections.intent: Help choosing: a quiet band pointing to support (/support) and contact options from <Store>
sections.layout: on a softly tinted surface

pages.label: Policies
pages.approach: Categories and best sellers up top, quick to shop, little preamble.

sections.label: Policies
sections.intent: Policies: <LegalContent /> full width on a calm surface under a thin rule
sections.layout: calm, with generous side space

sections.label: Questions
sections.intent: Questions: a quiet band pointing to support (/support) and contact options from <Store>
sections.layout: quiet, with thin rules between the parts

pages.label: Returns
pages.approach: Categories and best sellers up top, quick to shop, little preamble.

sections.label: Returns
sections.intent: Returns: a clear heading band (the page’s h1) with a short reassuring line that makes no promise, then <ReturnsContent /> full width
sections.layout: quiet, with thin rules between the parts

sections.label: Still need help
sections.intent: Still need help: contact options from <Store> and a link to support (/support)
sections.layout: type-led, with one accent colour

pages.label: Help and support
pages.approach: Categories and best sellers up top, quick to shop, little preamble.

sections.label: Help centre
sections.intent: Help centre: a warm heading band in the store voice (the page’s h1), then <SupportContent /> full width
sections.layout: type-led, with one accent colour

sections.label: Call or message
sections.intent: Call or message: a closing band inviting a call or a WhatsApp message through <Store>
sections.layout: quiet, with thin rules between the parts

pages.label: Page not found
pages.approach: Categories and best sellers up top, quick to shop, little preamble.

sections.label: Lost page
sections.intent: Lost page: an oversized 404 in the store’s type and a friendly line in the store voice (the h1), with <NotFoundContent /> under it
sections.layout: type-led, with one oversized accent

sections.label: New in
sections.intent: New in: the newest products from <Products> as the site’s product cards, under a short heading
sections.layout: calm, with thin rules between the parts
